experiment: Withhold selected original detail from Klein source conditioning using a native harmonic known-boundary fill.

protocol.prompt: Fixed generic Paint removal prompt, identical within every control/erasure pair.
protocol.model_parameters: Same pinned learned weights, strict tensor load, seed3941, four steps, guidance1, native1024square and decoder barriers.
protocol.source: Canonical pre-user-grade RAW context pinned and immutable. Only model conditioning changes within the binary hole. Coverage/protection and model-to-scene inverse remain unchanged.
protocol.runs: Five fresh processes this checkpoint; night control is the exact prior committed replay. No new control performance measurement for that case.

qualitative_findings.night-tiger-poster: Erasure removes the selected portrait poster that the unaltered-input control reproduced. Replacement tonality/material/grain consistency still require broader qualification.
qualitative_findings.coast-head: Both generic Paint variants remove the visible head; erasure avoids a visible pale blob left by the control near the protected railing. One small easy case, no general pass.
qualitative_findings.bologna-paint: Unaltered generic Paint preserves the blue-coated shopper; erasure removes that shopper and reconstructs market content. Person-like silhouettes and unselected adjacent person fragments remain, so full background-People removal is unqualified.
qualitative_findings.noise_assessment: The model-domain preview appeared smoother. Brightened RAW reconstruction contains substantial grain; manual horizontal-difference MAD is similar to one nearby known wall region. This does not prove physical noise matching or disprove localized texture/material seams.

limitations: No accepted XMP, model admission, app/render/export path, native context cap or shipping behavior changes.
The harmonic operator currently requires an interior hole; crop-edge/mask closure and grouped People remain separate qualification.
Rectangular Paint/protection controls are manual research annotations, not automatic object truth; the market mask deliberately cuts one adjacent person.
Public CC0 publisher statements remain pinned; no person model releases or consented release corpus are established.
Native1024square only; no larger/coherent native context or device/browser tier qualification.
Shared M5 Max128 GiB host; some unit tests overlapped initial model file verification. Timing is uncontrolled and does not establish p50/p95 or supported memory-tier performance.
No hidden-background ground truth, photographic acceptance budget, or physical shot-noise matching claim.
All model conversions, transitive licenses, distribution and signing remain unqualified.
next_work: Qualify complete-person masks and background-only conditioning, native larger contexts, full photographic/noise/structural gates, then integrate an admitted runtime into the Mac flow before porting.
